subject: Finexa security evidence & buying process - post-call recaps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@finexa.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finexa.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Finexa discovery - security stakeholders & next steps

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery call so we have aligned next steps and the stakeholder map: 

- Economic buyer: Tom Reynolds (VP Product) - will own TCO and procurement decisions.
- Security/infosec: Aisha Malik - primary reviewer for SOC 2/pen test/audit logs.
- Procurement: Sarah Lee - will coordinate PO and contract redlines.
- Technical reviewer: Finexa engineering (TBD) for SSO and network requirements.

Action items we committed to: 
1) I'll share Redwood security evidence (SOC 2 report, pen test summary, sample audit log) and a short notes doc mapping to your questionnaire by EOD Friday.
2) Aisha - if possible please share your procurement timeline and any mandatory evidence items we should prioritize.
3) Tom/Sarah - if you can confirm decision criteria (cost, latency SLA, data residency), we can prepare a brief TCO + deployment recommendation.

Expected next call: security deep-dive with Aisha + engineering (30-45m) — propose week of July 6.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

[attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf (pdf)]
From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@finexa.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finexa.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@finexa.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finexa discovery - security stakeholders & next steps

Marissa — thanks for the recap and file. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement timeline: target decision by end of July; legal review usually takes ~2 weeks after final SOW.
- Mandatory evidence: current checklist calls for SOC 2 Type II, external pen test summary, data retention policy, audit log export capability, and encryption-at-rest details. If you have a short one-pager mapping each item to your evidence, that’ll help our legal/security triage.

We can do a security deep-dive with our lead engineer and me on July 7 or 8 in the morning PT. Can you confirm availability?

Also, can you confirm whether Redwood supports SSO via SAML or OIDC and whether you can provide sample audit logs (redacted) showing access events? That will speed up our technical review.

Thanks,
Aisha Malik
Head of Security Operations
Finexa
aisha.malik@finexa.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@finexa.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finexa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finexa discovery - security stakeholders & next steps

Aisha — appreciate the checklist. Attached are the primary artifacts and a short mapping doc in the shared Drive. Highlights: 

- SOC 2: attached (Redwood_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf) — Type II, covers security and availability controls.
- Pen test: attached summary (Redwood_PenTest_Summary_2025.pdf) with remediation status. Full report available under NDA; we can coordinate offline.
- Audit logs: attached sample (audit-logs-sample-2026.csv) and link to our logs export guide. We capture admin/admin-login, token-issuance, model-inference events, and key management events.
- SSO: Redwood supports SAML and OIDC; we can provide SAML metadata and an SSO setup checklist during the technical call.
- Data retention: by default customer data retention is configurable; we have templates (30/90/365 day options) and can include retention clauses in the contract.

Ben/dylan — looping you both in to confirm we can provide the SAML metadata and a short demo for logs export on the July 7 call.

Next steps: 
- Please confirm July 7 9:30am PT for the security deep-dive.
- Aisha/Tom/Sarah: if there are any additional evidence items on your checklist, flag them so we can prioritize.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

[attachment: Redwood_PenTest_Summary_2025.pdf (pdf)]
[attachment: audit-logs-sample-2026.csv (csv)]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finexa discovery - security stakeholders & next steps

On it — Marissa, I'll prepare a brief SSO/SAML metadata package and a short runbook for logs export. Dylan, can you join the July 7 call to demo the logs export and walk through retention settings?

Also prepping a one-page TCO that includes expected per-token cost under typical batch sizes and options for Dedicated vs Hosted. Will have draft by July 2.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@finexa.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@finexa.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finexa discovery - security stakeholders & next steps

Thanks team — July 7 9:30am PT works for us. Confirmed attendees: Aisha (security), Finexa lead engineer (TBD), Tom (product), Sarah (procurement).

We reviewed the artifacts you shared and they look good for initial triage. A couple of asks before the call: 
- If you can provide the penetration test executive summary with remediation timelines (redacted where required) that will help our risk committee.
- Please include the SAML metadata + a short slide showing how audit logs are formatted (two example events minimum).
- Any notes about encryption key custody (customer-managed KMS or Redwood-managed) please include — that’s a gating item.

If you can upload the pen-test exec summary to the Drive link and add a short note on KMS options before EOD July 6, we’ll be ready to move quickly after the call.

Regards,
Aisha
Head of Security Operations | Finexa
